_comment: Vocabulary the transcriber should spell correctly. /setup writes member/lexicon.json with the member's own name, brand and niche terms; that file wins when it exists.
prompt: one sentence describing the speaker and topic — whisper uses it to spell names and jargon.
phrases: multi-word fixes; word count MUST match on both sides. replacements: single word to single word.
allowlist: words QA should not flag as misspellings.
prompt: A talking-head video about business, marketing, sales and AI.
